review: Reviewed the map on the actual structured F3 range, not arbitrary sources. The accepted paired graph/phase theorem gives fourteen local derivatives, regular bolt, mass/slow expansion and faster weight 4.005. Elementary local Sobolev embedding then defines the original five regular geometric observations; its full numerical norm and nonlinear admission remain unknown.

Checked the physical normalization beta E_s^2=<s,Abar s> using the original period/volume and rho_a factors. Thus the residual-to-energy factor S0/beta is correct. The 1/h physical radius cost is explicitly retained in the final bolt observable.

Verified the exact identity Abar^-1 Cbar T=u0+Abar^-1(Ebar T-2(Cv-1)Pbar T-Qbar u0), u0=L4^-1Pbar T/3. This uses Abar=6LDv L4+Qbar and Cbar=2LD0 Pbar+Ebar in their original order; no variable coefficient or inverse is commuted.

Reviewed the actual finite-geometry bolt Green proof. Its positive homogeneous decaying branch has negative radial derivative; rF G vanishes at both endpoints, including the logarithmic regular-bolt singularity. Integrating the drift against that Green kernel yields 13.5, not a derivative norm of T or an assumed product-bound transfer.

Reviewed full-form to physical gradient/Laplacian conversion with H_mu=z^-4 dz. The boundary products vanish for the structured phases. Bochner and scalar spectral inequalities use the same physical radial realization and Ricci lower bound. No original-source Y norm is inferred.

The complete residual includes the nonconstant-curvature Q term, the LDv-LD0 difference, every curvature anomaly density variation and the magnetic density. The generous 1e12 bound follows from the displayed two-jet tensor inequalities; it is not a finite-mode response estimate. Its actual R0 upper is 2.938504819e-6, and after all inverse/point costs its physical debit is 163.767297640, which still exceeds the physical margin and is not called negligible for certification.

The two full operator equations retain all quantum/contact/boundary terms in F and the actual mixed return. The old separated TT/scalar terms are replaced by the composed return, not added or silently deleted. No independently chosen source cancels the geometry.

The attained operator upper is 5.095722882e58 and its P32 physical upper is 2.555927720e16, improving the complete previous expression by 3.606046222e9. The remaining overrun is 1.533249982e25. These are positive-estimator values, not actual amplitudes or lower bounds on the construction.

The complete mixed return stays 1.370870984e10. Perfect removal of the entire composed scalar return still leaves an overrun of 8.223581183e18; perfect removal of the mixed return leaves 1.533249160e25. Therefore isolated optimization of either surviving return cannot close this estimator.

Conditional original defect, graph, mass-column and physical ceilings remain targets with unknown input maps, margins and errors. No new application-error bound is claimed: arbitrary two-row application errors do not possess the structured F3 cancellation.

The proposed signed adjoint transfer is a distinct sharper method against the same original target; it has not been evaluated. Its already rejected uniform .0022 residual replacement is not reused. All nonlinear, compatibility, physical matching, validity/noise and all-sector stability requirements remain unproved.

The first development failed only because an inherited Arb receipt stores an enclosure as a string. That frozen source/outcome is retained. The compatible parser was refrozen before the successful development; no formula or decision target changed.
